## Resolve Case

THE GATE: at least one outbound Customer Reply must exist among the caller-loaded replies or the command refuses, naming the rule and the fixing action. Writes the Case vocabulary (`resolved`), stamps resolvedOn, and stops every running clock on the linked SLA. duplicate-of requires its target.

```ts
import ResolveCaseCommand from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/service-desk/commands/resolve-case-command';

await new ResolveCaseCommand(commandContext).execute(input);
```

### Non-goals

No search (commands cannot see the realm — the caller loads the replies); closing≠archiving (Archive is separate, and only on terminal records).
